name: Peter Rabbit
description: Nickelodeon brings treasured literary icon Peter Rabbit to life with the new CG-animated preschool series, Peter Rabbit. The series is a fresh re-imagining of the popular Beatrix Potter children’s books based on Peter Rabbit. Peter Rabbit features educational goals that encourage preschoolers to learn problem-solving and interpersonal skills, self-efficacy, resilience, positive re-framing and fostering an interest in and respect for nature.

videos.title: Peter Rabbit's Christmas Tale
videos.overview: When Mr. Bouncer gets too sick to make the important holiday supply delivery, Peter and Benjamin take it upon themselves to brave a blizzard (and Mr. Tod) to get the job done and meet a new friend along the way.

videos.title: The Tale of the Missing Egg
videos.overview:
When Jemima's new egg goes missing, only Peter Rabbit is able to put the clues together and find the culprit. But can he find the egg before it hatches, or has he finally met his match in the devious newcomer Samuel Whiskers?

Also known as "The Tale of the Start of Spring"

videos.title: The Tale of the Rabbit and Squirrel Great Adventure
videos.overview: Peter tells a curious Cotton-tail how he and Squirrel Nutkin became friends and how the squirrel lost his tail. Soon Peter is on an adventure to retrieve Nutkin's tail, even though it means going to Owl Island!

videos.title: The Tale of the Scare Owl
videos.overview: When Peter uses a model to scare off Old Brown, he ends up scaring the squirrels away too! Peter must not only persuade the squirrels to return to their camp but also get Old Brown to leave his new roost – right over Benjamin's burrow!

videos.title: The Kitten and Pig Adventure
videos.overview: Peter meets some surprising new friends at Hill Top Farm, but when a big storm hits the woods, it's up to Peter to save the day.

videos.title: The Tale of the Unexpected Discovery
videos.overview: When Benjamin is accidentally taken inside Mr McGregor's house, Peter and Lily bravely venture inside to rescue him. Not only do they save their friend, but Peter is rewarded with something he never imagined he'd see - old film footage of his father.

videos.title: The Tale of Old Brown's New Roost
videos.overview: When Old Brown quits Owl Island in search of some peace and quiet, his new roost turns out to be a little too close to home for Peter, Lily and Benjamin.

videos.title: The Tale at the Start of Spring
videos.overview: When Jemima's new egg goes missing, only Peter Rabbit is able to put together the clues and find the culprit. But can he find the egg before it hatches, or has he finally met his match in devious newcomer Samuel Whiskers?

videos.title: The Tale of the Radish Robber
videos.overview: Peter and his friends try to find the perfect place to eat the radishes they took from Mr. McGregor's garden, but little do they know they've got a radish robber on their tails!

videos.title: The Tale of Two Enemies

videos.title: The Tale of Benjamin's Strawberry Raid

videos.title: The Tale of the Lying Fox

videos.title: The Tale of the Greedy Fox
videos.overview: When Peter tells an impulsive lie, which leads Jemima Puddle-Duck into Mr. Tod's clutches, he must act fast to stop her from becoming the fox's dinner

videos.overview: Peter proves he's got what it takes to be part of the squirrel tribe when he competes for his own treetop hideout.

videos.title: The Tale of the Angry Cat

videos.title: The Tale of Mr. Tod's Trap
videos.overview: When Peter, Benjamin and Lily are tempted by a mysterious hoard of radishes, Lily finds herself caught in Mr. Tod's trap. Can Peter find a way to rescue Lily before Mr. Tod reaches her?

videos.title: The Tale of Nutkin on the Run
videos.overview: When Squirrel Nutkin angers Old Brown by taking his glasses, it's up to Peter and his friends to put things right.

videos.title: The Tale of the Wriggly Worms
videos.overview: When Peter makes a rash promise to appease an angry Tommy Brock, he and his friends find themselves worming for their lives!

videos.title: The Tale of Jemima's Egg
videos.overview: When Peter is asked to watch Jemima's egg, he discovers that babysitting is far more dangerous than he could ever have imagined.

videos.title: The Tale of the Lucky Four Leaf Clover
